notes: Created from the 2026-10-19 HuggingFace discovery crawl. Benchmarks are the card's own published rows (vendor claims). architecture and task are inferred from the slug and param ratio; KV geometry, context length and quant sizes are not yet filled, hence status draft. KV basis: Grouped Differential Latent Attention keeps MLA's compressed KV latent (config: kv_lora_rank 512, qk_rope_head_dim 64, v_head_dim 128, q_lora_rank 1024): 53 layers x (512 + 64 = 576 values/token/layer) x 2 B (bf16) = 61,056 B/token. v_head_dim is up-projected from the same latent so it is not cached, and the differential signal/noise split happens along the expanded head dim on one shared latent (tech report sec. 4.1), so num_noise_heads 16 does not double the cache. This is the WORST CASE (all 53 layers holding the full latent): config sets sliding_window 128 with sliding_window_pattern 'interleave' and max_window_layers 9, so 9 of the 53 layers retain only a 128-token window. REVIEWED 2026-10-21: card confirms every claimed row. Card benchmark table matches all 6 rows.
